sloka: पिता च राजा काकुत्स्थः श्रीमान् सन्नः तदा बभौ ।परिपूर्णः शशी काले ग्रहेण उपप्लुतः यथा ॥२-४०-३०॥
transliteration: pitā ca rājā kākutsthaḥ śrīmān sannaḥ tadā babhau ।paripūrṇaḥ śaśī kāle graheṇa upaplutaḥ yathā ॥2-40-30॥

translations.english: The king born in the race of Kakutstha, though bright, looked dull then like the full Moon eclipsed (by Rahu).
